description: A script for running and analyzing performance tests, specifically for the ANGLE project. It executes performance benchmarks, collects results, and computes statistical metrics such as mean and coefficient of variation.

methods.name: mean
methods.description: Calculates the arithmetic mean of a list of data points.

methods.name: sum_of_square_deviations
methods.description: Calculates the sum of squared deviations from the mean.

methods.name: coefficient_of_variation
methods.description: Computes the population coefficient of variation for a dataset.

methods.name: truncated_list
methods.description: Returns a sorted list truncated by removing n elements from each end.

methods.name: truncated_mean
methods.description: Calculates the mean of a truncated list.

methods.name: truncated_cov
methods.description: Calculates the coefficient of variation of a truncated list.
